story: Explore the fascinating world of the Indigo Flycatcher (Eumyias indigo). The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Indigo Flycatcher is a testament to the intricate web of life.
